description: This file defines the NatsAdapter class, which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for integrating NATS streaming with Orleans. It provides methods for creating receivers and queuing message batches, encapsulating NATS-specific logic.

classes.name: NatsAdapter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IQueueAdapter for NATS streaming integration, providing message queuing and receiver creation functionalities.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NatsQueueAdapterReceiver for the specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously serializes and enqueues a batch of messages to NATS.
